basis.title: How the targets are set
basis.what:
The number of bowls to aim for in one shift (morning / evening / night).
Bowls = ramen + chashu-men (coupons not included).
Set per month for each store × shift × day type.
basis.typesIntro: Days off = Saturday, Sunday and public holidays (from the Japanese calendar). Each date gets one type:

type.weekday: A working day followed by a working day.
type.friday: A working day followed by a day off (usual Friday, day before a holiday).
type.saturday: A Saturday followed by Sunday, not part of a 3-day break.
type.sunday_holiday: The last day off before a working day (usual Sunday, a single holiday).
type.long_holiday: Days of a break of 3+ days off, except the last one.
type.peak:
New Year (12/29–1/3) and Obon (8/13–8/16), whatever the weekday.
Also Golden Week (the break including 5/3–5/5) and Silver Week (a break of 4+ days in September), except their last day, which is Sunday/holiday (sales drop before work starts again).

basis.typesExample:
Example: Sat–Sun–Mon (holiday) → Sat, Sun = long holiday, Mon = Sunday/holiday, the Friday before = Friday/day before a holiday.
Example: GW 2026, 5/2 (Sat)–5/6 (Wed) → 5/2–5/5 = peak, 5/6 = Sunday/holiday.
basis.initial:
The 2025 average per day for the same month and day type (goal: back to the 2025 level).
When the month has fewer than 3 days of that type:
2025 same-month weekday average × factor (how many times a weekday that type sold over all of 2025).
Example: weekday 100, Saturday = 1.5 × weekday over the year → Saturday target 150.
GW / SW peak (April, September): the weekday target × how many times a weekday GW / SW 2026 sold, per shift (about 2–4 ×).
May–July 2027 are not set yet (GW 2027 is 5/1–5/5, so it has no target yet).
basis.events:
Hanshin games, Halloween…: the target of those dates goes up or down by a % (see Events below).
Target = day-type target × (1 + %). Two events on the same day are multiplied.
Example: Saturday 600, Hanshin −20% → 480.
The % were measured on the 2025 days of the same events. OFF = not used.
basis.use:
・Shift-start meeting: the target is filled in (tick 「修正」 to change it).
・Daily sales report: target and achievement.
・Manager → Analysis: achievement, month-end forecast…
Without a target: 「目標のデータがありません。」
basis.change:
Edit the table and press Save. 「Copy last month」 also works.
Targets of meetings and sales reports already sent do not change. Manager → Analysis recalculates with the saved targets (past days too).

how.tap: ⓘ Tap a figure or a chart to see how it is calculated and its numbers.
how.achievementNote: Only days and shifts with figures are counted (the target of the same days and shifts). Targets include the event %. Bowls = ramen + chashu-men (coupons not included).
how.yoy:
YoY = [[this year total || last year total]] − 1
= [[{{cur}} || {{ly}}]] − 1
= {{yoy}}%
how.yoyNote: Last year = 364 days before (same weekday). Only days and shifts with figures in both years. Grey days have no figure last year.
how.forecastNote: Days from today without figures are counted at their target (day type and event %).
how.bestNote: Days with a missing shift are left out.

analysis.weekTrendHelp: Average bowls per day of each week (Mon–Sun), one line per year (blue = this year, orange = last year), same week number. Weeks with fewer than 4 complete days are left empty.
analysis.typeYears: Day types of month {{month}} vs the same month of earlier years
analysis.typeYearsHelp: Average bowls per day for each of the six day types, compared with the same month of earlier years. Only complete days; years without data are left out. YoY = this year ÷ last year − 1.

daily.formula:
Actual = bowls of the day (ramen + chashu-men)
Target = day-type target × (1 + event %)
Achievement = [[actual || target]] × 100
daily.note:
Bar colour = achievement (actual ÷ target): green ≥ 100%, orange 90–99%, red < 90%, grey = no target.
Targets include the event %.
Total of the selected stores and shifts. Bowls = ramen + chashu-men (coupons not included).

monthly.formula: Average per day = [[bowls of the month || complete days]]
monthly.note:
Only days with every shift filled in. One line per year (blue = this year, orange = last year).
Months with fewer than 5 such days are left empty. Figures before 2025 are not used.

weekly.formula: Weekly average = [[bowls of the week (Mon–Sun) || complete days]]
weekly.note:
Only days with every shift filled in. One line per year, same week number compared.
Week numbers: weeks start on Monday; week 1 holds the first Thursday of the year.
Weeks with fewer than 4 such days are left empty.

yoyWeekly.formula: YoY = [[bowls of the week || same weekdays last year (−364 days)]] − 1
yoyWeekly.note:
Only days with figures in both years. Above 0% = more than last year.
Red dashed line = start of the meetings and patrols (10/12).

patrol.formula:
Patrol average = [[sum of the scores of the week || number of patrols]]
Score of a patrol with ⑤ = "－" = [[total || 20]] × 25
patrol.note: Only patrols of the selected stores and shifts.

explain.dayNote: Targets include the event %. A shift without figures is not counted in the target either.
explain.typeCellNote: Only the "{{type}}" days of this month with every slot filled in.
explain.typeYearNote: The "{{type}}" days of month {{month}} of each year with every shift filled in; years without data are left out.
explain.band:
Achievement = [[actual of the patrolled shifts || their targets]] × 100
= [[{{a}} || {{t}}]] × 100 = {{rate}}%
explain.bandNote: Sales achievement of the shifts whose patrol score (on 25) was "{{band}}".
explain.eventHead: Measured effect = [[actual on the event days || target without the event]] − 1
explain.eventNote: Target without the event = the day-type target before the event %.
